title.zh: 清洗与平坦化：管理表面和地形
title.en: Cleaning and planarization: manage surfaces and topography

subtitle.en: Particles, metal, residue, surface state and planarity

body.zh: 清洗 | 控制污染与表面状态；确认来料表面；Particles（颗粒）；Organics（有机物）；Metals（金属离子）；Residue（残留物）；表面存在多种污染
body.en: Cleaning: control contamination and surface condition Confirm incoming surface Particles Organics Metals (metal ions) Residue Multiple contaminants exist on the surface

body.zh: 化学/物理清洗；化学反应/机械作用；去除污染物
body.en: Chemical / physical cleaning Chemical reactions / mechanical action remove contaminants

body.zh: DI漂洗；去除化学残留；和松散颗粒
body.en: DI rinse Remove chemical residue and loose particles

body.zh: 干燥；去除水分，仍可能；残留少量颗粒/痕迹
body.en: Dry Remove water, while some particles / marks may remain

body.zh: 表面检查；检测并评估表面状态，；仍有残留/缺陷可能
body.en: Inspect the surface Inspect and assess surface condition; residue / defects may still remain

body.zh: 颗粒；有机物残留；金属残留；残留物/薄膜；潜在缺陷/风险
body.en: Particles Organic residue Metal residue Residue / film Potential defect / risk

body.zh: CMP |优先去除高处实现平坦化；前序沉积后；（有地形差异）；前序沉积填充后，；仍存在地形起伏
body.en: CMP: preferentially remove high regions to planarize After preceding deposition (with topographic differences) After deposition and fill, topographic relief remains

body.zh: Pad/Slurry接触；压力；Pad与Slurry接触，；化学+机械作用；开始去除材料
body.en: Pad / slurry contact Pressure Pad and slurry contact; chemical + mechanical action begins removing material

body.zh: 优先去除高处；高处受力/反应更强，；去除速率更高；；低处去除较少
body.en: Preferential removal of high regions Higher regions see stronger force/reaction and higher removal rates; lower regions lose less material

body.zh: 接近终点；（共面化）；高处被去除后，；表面趋于共面
body.en: Approach endpoint (coplanarity) After high regions are removed, the surface approaches coplanarity

body.zh: Post-CMP Clean；（去除残留）；去除残留Slurry、；金属离子与颗粒
body.en: Post-CMP clean (remove residue) Remove residual slurry, metal ions and particles

body.zh: 平坦化结果；表面达到全局平坦，；地形差异显著降低
body.en: Planarized result The surface becomes globally planar, substantially reducing topographic differences

body.zh: CMP负责去除高处，不负责填充低处；低处填充发生在前序沉积。
body.en: CMP removes high regions; it does not fill low regions, which are filled during preceding deposition

body.zh: 上层薄膜；阻挡层/硬掩膜；介质层（ILD）；金属层；衬底
body.en: Upper film Barrier / hard mask Dielectric (ILD) Metal layer Substrate

body.zh: 1 清洗控制；Particle；Metal；Residue；Surface State
body.en: 1 Cleaning controls Particle Metal Residue Surface state

body.zh: 2 CMP控制；Removal Rate；WIWNU；Selectivity；Endpoint
body.en: 2 CMP controls Removal rate WIWNU Selectivity Endpoint

body.zh: 3 耦合权衡；清洗能力 ↑；Surface Damage/；Corrosion风险可能 ↑
body.en: 3 Coupled trade-offs Cleaning capability ↑; surface damage / corrosion risk may ↑

body.zh: Removal Rate ↑；Scratch/；Dishing/Erosion风险可能 ↑
body.en: Removal rate ↑; scratch / dishing / erosion risk may ↑

body.zh: 前序Fill质量 → 决定CMP余量；与Void暴露风险
body.en: Previous fill quality → determines CMP margin and risk of exposing voids

body.zh: 4 常见失效；Watermark；Particle；Corrosion；Scratch；Dishing；Erosion
body.en: 4 Common failures Watermark Particle Corrosion Scratch Dishing Erosion

body.zh: 量测反馈：Defect Map / Thickness / Topography / Surface Analysis；Defect Map；（缺陷分布）；> 100；50-100；10-50；1-10
body.en: Metrology feedback: defect map / thickness / topography / surface analysis Defect map (defect distribution) >100 50–100 10–50 1–10

body.zh: Thickness Map（厚度分布）；nm；+20；+10；-10；-20
body.en: Thickness map (thickness distribution) nm +20 +10 −10 −20

body.zh: Topography（轮廓）；50；25；Height （nm）；-25；-50；20；40；60；80；100；Position (µm)
body.en: Topography (profile) 50 25 Height (nm) −25 −50 20 40 60 80 100 Position (µm)

body.zh: Surface Analysis（表面分析）；nm；20；-20；5 µm
body.en: Surface analysis nm 20 −20 5 µm

body.zh: 影响：；Adhesion / Lithography Focus / Overlay / Contact R / Yield
body.en: Impact: Adhesion / lithography focus / overlay / contact resistance / yield

body.zh: 清洗化学、Slurry、Pad 与Endpoint策略会随材料体系、结构和Fab政策变化。
body.en: Cleaning chemistry, slurry, pad and endpoint strategies vary with materials, structures and fab policy
